title: Law to require review of cooling towers linked to Legionnaires' outbreaks
summary: This bill would require the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene, working with the Department of Buildings, to analyze the shared traits of cooling towers tied to each Legionnaires' disease cluster within three months after the cluster ends. Within 30 days of finishing each analysis, the department must publish a report with findings and recommendations to prevent future outbreaks, potentially including changes to city codes. It is one of several bills the Council Health Committee considered on September 2, 2026 addressing the city's cooling tower rules.
